title: Effect of Mechanical Alloying and Sintering Behavior on the Microstructure and Properties of NbMoTaWRe Refractory High Entropy Alloy
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) for 30 hours with a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 20:1 and milling speed of 400 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1700-1900°C for 20 min under 50 MPa pressure in argon atmosphere.
